description: Google Ads MCP: GAQL queries, resources, recommendations, keyword ideas, change history. 11 tools.
name: io.scalably/google-ads-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Google Ads API developer token from the Ads API Center
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_DEVELOPER_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 client_id for a Desktop-app credential
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 client_secret paired with the client_id
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Long-lived OAuth2 refresh_token for the adwords scope
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_REFRESH_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: 10-digit customer ID of the manager account (MCC)
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_LOGIN_CUSTOMER_ID

environmentVariables.description: Google Ads API version to target, default set by the server
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_API_VERSION

environmentVariables.description: Use proto-plus message types, default true
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_USE_PROTO_PLUS

title: Google Ads MCP
